execution_safety.provider_cost_note: Provider-reported cost was unavailable in all runs.

failure_analysis.safe_description: The candidate made one question after two generations and used read-only graph/observation tools. WHAT was accepted on its first attempt. The first HOW parsed as JSON but omitted planned semantic items; the two retries did not pass strict response parsing. The existing three-attempt HOW bound raised StakeholderResponseError before any public response was accepted.

The candidate made one question after two generations and used read-only graph/observation tools. The first two WHAT attempts failed strict parsing, including one provider generation with a max_tokens stop and no visible completion; the third WHAT was accepted. The first HOW parsed as JSON but omitted planned semantic items, and the two retries failed strict parsing. The existing three-attempt HOW bound terminated the run.

The candidate asked one question directly with no graph tool call. WHAT was accepted on its first attempt. The first HOW parsed as JSON but contained a non-exact annotation quote span; both retries had no visible completion and failed strict parsing. No public response or primary score was produced.

failure_categories.A_candidate_interview_strategy: No candidate_did_not_ask_question failure occurred. All three runs asked exactly one question before the stakeholder block; later strategy was not observable.
failure_categories.B_candidate_graph_tool_usage: The lab and English quotation runs only read the empty graph and observations; the Japanese run used no graph tool. No graph mutation was reached, so graph reconstruction quality is unmeasured.
failure_categories.C_stakeholder_what: WHAT eventually passed in 3/3 runs. The English quotation run needed two WHAT retries; lab and Japanese quotation passed on attempt one.
failure_categories.D_stakeholder_how: HOW failed in 3/3 runs. Failures included missing planned semantic items, invalid visible JSON, and a non-exact quote span.
failure_categories.E_stakeholder_semantic_validation_retry: There were 11 rejected semantic attempts and 8 retries. Each run exhausted the existing HOW attempt bound.
failure_categories.F_runtime_protocol_limits: Inspect logged status=error while persisted runtime status remained active because the existing stakeholder error propagated before a terminal runtime state or primary scorer result.
failure_categories.G_evaluator_alignment: No run reached PrimaryEvaluation. Evaluator, evidence, provenance, fabrication, and alignment weaknesses cannot be ranked from this calibration.
failure_categories.H_scenario_profile_difficulty: The same HOW blocker appeared across lab, English quotation, and Japanese quotation profiles. This supports a cross-scenario runtime blocker, not a scenario-specific score conclusion.

phase15_comparison.evidence_assessment: Evidence cannot be evaluated because all runs stopped before primary scoring; the measured dominant blocker is stakeholder HOW.
phase15_comparison.phase15_tool_error_pattern_note: Phase15 reported unknown concept references and invalid evidence quote spans in its lab run; Phase18 reached neither tool mutation nor evidence attachment, so neither category occurred.
phase15_comparison.semantic_correctness_assessment: Not measurable in Phase18: no run produced the 41-field primary score. No semantic correctness zero is inferred.

phase19_primary_target.basis: All three independent scenario runs reached WHAT but failed HOW, producing zero accepted public responses and zero primary scores. This is the first cross-scenario correctness/integration blocker measured in Phase18.

primary_evaluation.score_interpretation: No run reached PrimaryEvaluation because stakeholder HOW failed before the runtime could append a public response. Node/edge, evidence, fabrication, and semantic score fields are therefore not measured in Phase18; no zero score is inferred.

reasoning_spike_assessment.conclusion: The low request did not eliminate a Phase16-scale individual reasoning outlier. It also did not create a benchmark threshold; the outlier is reported descriptively from these 14 generations.

descriptive_outlier.description: This was the maximum reasoning generation in the observed distribution; the next-highest stakeholder generation was 7665 reasoning tokens.

structured_response.interpretation: All three runs eventually accepted WHAT. No run accepted HOW; each ended after the existing three-attempt realization bound.
